ocr.notes: Hand transcript matches the short item.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported that Tom Allen and Tom Kelly appeared at the Theatre Comique the night before and received a grand reception before a crowded house.

metadata.notes: 1876-09-22 is before 1878-12, so the paper is the Evening Dispatch. Masthead not checked.

facts.fact: Allen and Tom Kelly appeared on stage at the Theatre Comique, St. Louis, and were given a grand reception before a crowded house

notes: Allen and Kelly were appearing just after the Goss fight (Sept 1876); text does not say so.
